title: athyrium molle
intro: Athyrium molle, commonly known as Lady-in-Lake or Western Lady Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Athyriaceae. This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium molle are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins that have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been shown to exhibit hepatoprotective and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
